## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the handheld round blue cup onto the small drink-protecting wooden coaster gently.

Task description: Gently place the blue round cup on the right side of the table onto the small round wooden coaster to its left, then release the cup.

Success criteria: Place the blue cup on the wooden coaster's supporting surface, with close horizontal alignment and seated height. Both grippers must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- With the cup open, consider grasping a continuous wall section below the rim, one finger inside and one against the corresponding outside. Match the opening to wall thickness and surrounding clearance, placing the pads on the wall to reduce slipping from a grip only on the thin edge.
- Before closing, confirm the inside finger has passed the cup rim and the fingers lie on opposite wall sides. If they only overlap visually, adjust position or viewpoint to avoid pressing the rim or tipping the cup.
- Keep the cup opening upward during movement and its base clear of the table, avoiding dragging across the tabletop or hitting the coaster edge during lateral motion.
- Near the coaster, use its circular boundary to check cup-bottom placement and lower slowly. Release after obtaining support, then withdraw the inside finger clear of the rim to reduce impact or tipping.
